references.title: Tristan da Cunha Outer Islands: Inaccessible Island
references.role: Official Tristan da Cunha island-group source; physical setting and outer-island relation.
references.date_or_vintage: No publication date stated; fetched 2026-10-03. The unchanged bytes match the #503 observation first recorded 2026-10-02.
inspected_facts: The official page labels Inaccessible an outer island of Tristan da Cunha.
The page describes an extinct volcanic island, a dissected plateau reaching 449 m at Cairn Peak, sheer sea cliffs and only a few boulder beaches.
It says the island is uninhabited and rarely visited except by conservationists.
